result.answer: The transfer to WARD-B at 09:20 UTC never reached the demo patient records system (Records Out) because it was unavailable. A later transfer to WARD-C, bed BAY1-07, at 09:45 UTC did go through, so Records Out shows the patient on WARD-C at version 2. Records Out keeps a full movement history (W1), so a person must add the missing WARD-B stay as a past movement. If Records Out only needed the current placement, this case would close with nothing to send and no escalation, because WARD-C is already right. Either way, the old message is not resent, because that could put the patient back on WARD-B. The only difference is that the history would stay WARD-A then WARD-C. The members agree on this. Encounter notes that the alternative's wording mentions cancelling and replaying, but the steps keep WARD-C. Impact cannot tell who reads that history. Conformance says the message looks sound but Records Out never judged it. Changing the setting is a draft a person reviews on the Site profile page. It would affect every overtaken failure at Records Out. I cannot change it.

perspectives.view: The WARD-B transfer no longer reflects where the patient is. Only the fact that the stay happened still matters, and only for a history-keeping system. The alternative's wording about cancelling and replaying doesn't match the steps, which keep WARD-C.

With current placement only, nothing changes for readers of the current location, which stays WARD-C. The WARD-B stay would stay missing from the history. Shutter cannot tell which systems read that history.
The ADT^A02 parses cleanly against 2.5.1. The failure was an unavailable system (HTTP 503), not a rejection. The check covers structure only, so whether Records Out would accept it is unknown.

suggested_change.why: Fits a records system that only needs the current placement. It is a draft for a person to review on the Site profile page.
